study type: Secondary analysis of a prospective cohort study
exposure: Timing of repeat cesarean (pre-labor vs. intrapartum)
cohort: 3,143 women with a singleton gestation and a history of one prior cesarean delivery, from a larger cohort of 26,465 women who delivered between January 2017 and April 2020 in Chimaltenango, Guatemala
finding: Maternal and neonatal outcomes did not appear to differ based on the timing of repeat cesarean birth.
mod_finding: Hypertensive disease was associated with an increased likelihood of pre-labor cesarean.
